text:
Their frases never me hirieron

and always me consolaron…

¡Heridas that otras me abrieron,

their propias hands cerraron!


Aun when penaba tanto,

tan buena conmigo was,

that until me ocultaba el llanto

for that I no sufriera.


With his infinita ternura,

my more intensa amargura

supo always consolar…


¡And what buena no sería,

that al morirse sonreía

for no verme llorar!

translation.title: Sonetillo
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
